mhl.help: The media industry's proof of copy (ASC Media Hash List), read by tools such as Silverstack and Hedge. Kept in an ascmhl folder with the copied files; a history the files already have is continued. Files already in the destination are read too, so the history lists them.

ignore.empty: No patterns. Secopy's own working files are still left out.

report.label: Also save the job report next to the checksum file
report.help: Every job's report is also kept in the app; this adds a copy next to the checksum file.

notify.label: Notify when a copy finishes
notify.help: Only when Secopy's window isn't in front. macOS asks for permission the first time.

menuBar.label: Keep copying in the menu bar when the window is closed
menuBar.help: Closing the window during a job hides it; a menu bar icon shows the progress and brings it back. When off, closing asks to stop the job.

transfer.title: Settings and presets
transfer.about: Move your settings and presets to a new Mac, or share presets, in a .secopy file.

verify.about: Choose the directory of a copy, or a whole drive: Secopy reads every file its checksum files list and compares it. Nothing is written to it.
